en.title: Maximum Contiguous Subarray Sum with Length at Least K
en.description:
Choose a non-empty contiguous subarray of length at least K that maximizes the sum of its elements. The catalog's second example answer of −5 is wrong; [-2,1] has the larger sum −1.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; missing numeric ranges are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N K, and the second line contains N integers. The source has no numeric ranges; this site uses 1≤K≤N≤100000 and elements in −10⁹..10⁹.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: choose three elements, for a total of 13. Example 2: choose −2, 1, for a total of −1, correcting the source example's −5. Example 3: choose the single element −2; an empty array is not allowed.
hints: Iterate over the right end r, and subtract the minimum prefix sum at indices ≤r−K from the current prefix sum.
